--MOCK:
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE tds_order_info (
    id                     BIGINT,
    consignee              NVARCHAR(100),
    consignee_tel          NVARCHAR(20),
    total_amount           DECIMAL(10,2),
    order_status           NVARCHAR(20),
    user_id                BIGINT,
    payment_way            NVARCHAR(20),
    delivery_address       NVARCHAR(1000),
    order_comment          NVARCHAR(200),
    out_trade_no           NVARCHAR(50),
    trade_body             NVARCHAR(200),
    create_time            DATETIME2,
    operate_time           DATETIME2,
    expire_time            DATETIME2,
    process_status         NVARCHAR(20),
    tracking_no            NVARCHAR(100),
    parent_order_id        BIGINT,
    img_url                NVARCHAR(200),
    province_id            INT,
    activity_reduce_amount DECIMAL(16,2),
    coupon_reduce_amount   DECIMAL(16,2),
    original_total_amount  DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee             DECIMAL(16,2),
    feight_fee_reduce      DECIMAL(16,2),
    refundable_time        DATETIME2--,
    --CONSTRAINT PK_ods_order_info PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED (id) NOT ENFORCED  -- 定义主键
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_order_info/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_order_detail
(
    id                    bigint ,
    order_id              bigint        ,
    sku_id                bigint         ,
    sku_name              NVARCHAR(200)   ,
    img_url               NVARCHAR(200)   ,
    order_price           decimal(10, 2),
    sku_num               bigint         ,
    create_time           datetime2       ,
    split_total_amount    decimal(16, 2) ,
    split_activity_amount decimal(16, 2) ,
    split_coupon_amount   decimal(16, 2) ,
    operate_time          datetime2
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'tds_order_detail/',
    DATA_SOURCE = tds_external_source,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
);

create EXTERNAL table tds_payment_info

create EXTERNAL table tds_user_info

WITH (
